rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Beyond standard monument-establishment clauses, the two proclamations use an unusually close sequence and wording for National Park Service management: a three-year plan developed with public involvement and a named partner; two nearly identical preservation-and-interpretation purposes; a requirement to define relationships with resources, programs, and organizations inside and outside the National Park System; and an agreements clause listing the same five categories of cooperative activity. C20 and C14 share substantial portions of this machinery, but C09 is the closest literal and structural match.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Interior shall prepare a management plan within 3 years of the date of this proclamation, with full public involvement, and to include coordination with Penn Center, Inc., Brick Baptist Church, the Department of the Navy, Atlantic Marine Corps Communities, LLC, the City of Beaufort, and the Town of Port Royal.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary shall prepare a management plan, with full public involvement and in coordination with the NWP, within 3 years of the date of this proclamation.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical planning mandate, deadline, public-participation requirement, and coordination mechanism, adapted to different stakeholders.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The management plan shall ensure that the monument fulfills the following purposes for the benefit of present and future generations: (1) to preserve and protect the objects of historic interest associated with the monument, and (2) to interpret the objects, resources, and values related to the Reconstruction Era.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The management plan shall ensure that the monument fulfills the following purposes for the benefit of present and future generations: (1) to preserve and protect the objects of historic interest associated with the monument, and (2) to interpret the monument's objects, resources, and values related to the women's rights movement.
shared_material.explanation: The operative sentence is essentially reproduced, with only the historical subject changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The management plan shall, among other things, set forth the desired relationship of the monument to other related resources, programs, and organizations, both within and outside the National Park System.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The management plan shall, among other things, set forth the desired relationship of the monument to other related resources, programs, and organizations, both within and outside the National Park System.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The National Park Service is directed to use applicable authorities to seek to enter into agreements with others to address common interests and promote management efficiencies, including provision of visitor services, interpretation and education, establishment and care of museum collections, and preservation of historic objects.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The National Park Service is directed to use applicable authorities to seek to enter into agreements with others, and the NWP in particular, to address common interests and promote management efficiencies, including provision of visitor services, interpretation and education, establishment and care of museum collections, and preservation of historic objects.
shared_material.explanation: Virtually verbatim cooperative-management clause, including the same distinctive enumeration of services and functions.
